mapper.select: SELECT game_state_id AS gameStateId, participant_id AS participantId, session_id AS sessionId, scenario_id AS scenarioId, initial_cash AS initialCash, cash_balance AS cashBalance, stock_principal AS stockPrincipal, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, deposit_amount AS depositAmount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM event_game_states WHERE participant_id = #{participantId}

SELECT game_state_id AS gameStateId, participant_id AS participantId, session_id AS sessionId, scenario_id AS scenarioId, initial_cash AS initialCash, cash_balance AS cashBalance, stock_principal AS stockPrincipal, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, deposit_amount AS depositAmount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM event_game_states WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_game_states ( participant_id, session_id, scenario_id, initial_cash, cash_balance, stock_principal, stock_quantity, deposit_amount ) VALUES ( #{participantId}, #{sessionId}, #{scenarioId}, #{initialCash}, #{cashBalance}, #{stockPrincipal}, #{stockQuantity}, #{depositAmount} )
